## Description
Provide a concise summary of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

## Related Issues
- Closes #

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Documentation update / CI update

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style guidelines of this project (`ruff check .`)
- [ ] Formatting is clean and matches project standards (`ruff format --check .`)
- [ ] Static type checks pass (`mypy backend scripts`)
- [ ] I have added/updated unit tests covering my changes
- [ ] All new and existing tests pass locally (`pytest`)
- [ ] Coverage threshold ($\ge 80\%$) is maintained
- [ ] Security audit passes (`bandit` & `pip-audit`)
- [ ] Docker image builds successfully without warnings
